title: Stocks Rise, Oil Pares Gain on Iran Talks Report: Markets Wrap
title_zh: 伊朗谈判报告推动股市上涨、油价上涨：市场结束
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Stocks rose and crude oil pared gains as investors cautiously returned to equities, encouraged by indications the Iran-US conflict may be contained.Benchmark stock indexes in Japan and South Korea both gained more than 1%, helping boost the MSCI Asia Pacific Ind...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——受伊朗与美国冲突可能得到遏制的迹象的鼓舞，投资者谨慎地重返股市，股市上涨，原油回吐涨幅。日本和韩国基准股指均上涨超过 1%，帮助提振了 MSCI 亚太指数。

title: Stock market today: Oil surges, futures fall as Trump ratchets up threats against Iran
title_zh: 今日股市：特朗普加大对伊朗的威胁，油价飙升，期货下跌
summary: Oil rose and stock futures fell on Sunday night as investors aimed to make sense of a busy weekend in the US-Iran conflict.
summary_zh: 周日晚间，油价上涨，股指期货下跌，投资者希望了解美伊冲突中繁忙的周末。

title: Inflation readings, oil volatility, and airline earnings: What to watch this week
title_zh: 通胀数据、石油波动和航空公司盈利：本周值得关注的内容
summary: Inflation readings, Delta earnings, and more Middle East volatility are set to headline the week ahead.
summary_zh: 通胀数据、达美航空盈利以及更多中东波动将成为未来一周的焦点。

title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai’s Sales Meet Estimates on Solid AI Demand
title_zh: Nvidia 合作伙伴鸿海的销售额符合人工智能强劲需求的预期
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported a 29.7% rise in quarterly sales, a sign of sustained AI demand during the first weeks of war in the Middle East.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——鸿海精密工业有限公司公布季度销售额增长 29.7%，这表明中东战争头几周人工智能需求持续增长。

title: Foxconn first-quarter revenue jumps, company cautions on geopolitics
title_zh: 富士康第一季度营收大幅增长，公司对地缘政治发出警告
summary: Taiwan's Foxconn, the world's largest contract electronics maker, reported a 29.7% on-year rise in first-quarter revenue ‌on strong demand for artificial intelligence products, though it cautioned ‌about "volatile" global politics.
summary_zh: 全球最大的合同电子产品制造商台湾富士康报告称，由于对人工智能产品的强劲需求，第一季度收入同比增长 29.7%，不过该公司对“不稳定”的全球政治发出了警告。

title: Russia’s VPN Crackdown Caused Bank Outage, Telegram Founder Says
title_zh: Telegram 创始人称俄罗斯对 VPN 的打击导致银行中断
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Russia’s attempts to restrict the use of virtual private networks amid a clampdown on the Telegram messaging platform triggered the widespread banking outage seen across the country this week, the service’s billionaire founder Pavel Durov said.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——该服务的亿万富翁创始人帕维尔·杜罗夫（Pavel Durov）表示，俄罗斯在打压 Telegram 消息平台的过程中试图限制虚拟专用网络的使用，引发了本周全国范围内广泛的银行业务中断。
